metadata.description: Agent skills for research, writing, presentations, diagrams, design workflows, and more.

plugins.name: atlassian
plugins.description: Use Jira and Confluence from agent workflows.

plugins.name: google-workspace
plugins.description: Use Gmail and Calendar through gws.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Research complex topics and produce sourced reports.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Ghostwrite pieces from the owner's own facts, or get coached to write them yourself.

plugins.name: runtime-bridge
plugins.description: Align Claude Code and Codex project configuration.

plugins.name: agent-system-management
plugins.description: Audit AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md, capture session learnings, and create Claude Code / Codex skills.

plugins.name: workbench
plugins.description: Personal Workbench skills for design and autonomous feature work.

plugins.name: terminal
plugins.description: Control interactive terminal programs through tmux.

plugins.name: playground
plugins.description: Generate interactive single-file HTML playgrounds with controls, live preview, and copy-out prompt for two-way feedback with the model.

plugins.name: databricks
plugins.description: Databricks skills: databricks-core (CLI, auth, profiles, ported from databricks/databricks-agent-skills) and databricks-docs (live docs.databricks.com lookups via WebFetch).

plugins.name: learning
plugins.description: Socratic teach-and-quiz skills plus a pre-work blind-spot survey, so you deeply understand a session, a topic, or an unfamiliar area.

plugins.name: critique
plugins.description: Critique ideas, plans, and decisions through independent thinking frames, one fresh subagent each, with verdicts shown word for word and one decision.

plugins.name: presentations
plugins.description: Presentation lifecycle skills: content design, HTML deck building with brand presets and a perfecting loop, a local deck editor, native PPTX export, and preset extraction.

plugins.name: diagrams
plugins.description: Draw validated, themeable architecture and flow diagrams as interactive HTML.

plugins.name: news
plugins.description: Build a personal daily newspaper in a kasten vault, linked from the daily note, shaped by your feedback.

plugins.name: insights
plugins.description: Find what went wrong in yesterday's Claude Code sessions and newspaper runs, with one concrete fix per problem on a page in a kasten vault.

plugins.name: file-size
plugins.description: Cap every authored file in a repo at 5000 tokens (bytes/4), checked on commit, on push and in CI, with advice to split along deep modules.
